# Task Summary

Plan a focused `PK-005` regression fix for the quick-view modal on `/pokedex`. The goal is to restore the intended overlay behavior when users activate `Quick view` from the browse grid, while preserving direct navigation to the canonical detail page at `/pokedex/[pokemon]`.

Scope is intentionally narrow:
- reproduce the runtime regression
- repair the trigger/interception seam
- add regression coverage for the modal flow

This plan does not expand the feature, redesign the modal, or change the canonical detail route.

# Affected Area Summary

- `src/components/pokedex/pokemon-summary-card.tsx`
  - Current modal trigger and canonical profile link live here.
- `src/app/pokedex/layout.tsx`
  - Renders both the browse content and the modal slot.
- `src/app/pokedex/@modal/(.)[pokemon]/*`
  - Intercepted modal route, loading, and error surfaces.
- `src/components/ui/modal-shell.tsx`
  - Handles close behavior, focus, and overlay interactions.
- `src/components/pokemon-detail/pokemon-quick-view.tsx`
  - Product-facing modal content.
- regression coverage under existing test/browser setup
  - Needed because this flow currently has no automated protection.

# Implementation Approach

Treat this as a route-seam regression, not a data or visual regression.

The recommended implementation is:

- reproduce the current runtime symptom in a browser first
- verify whether `Quick view` incorrectly performs a full-page navigation or fails to open anything
- harden the trigger path in `src/components/pokedex/pokemon-summary-card.tsx` so modal intent is explicit and resilient
- verify intercepted-route matching still works under `src/app/pokedex/layout.tsx`
- keep canonical direct visits to `/pokedex/[pokemon]` rendering the full detail page
- add regression coverage for:
  - opening the modal from `/pokedex`
  - closing via button/backdrop/`Escape`
  - opening the full profile intentionally
  - direct navigation to `/pokedex/[pokemon]` rendering a full page, not a modal

What stays out of scope:

- redesigning modal copy or layout
- changing detail-page data flow
- broad browse-route refactors
- non-modal detail UX changes

# Architecture Notes

- Primary risk area:
  - The current trigger depends on intercepted routing semantics while linking to the canonical detail URL.
  - If client navigation stops being interpreted as an intercepted transition, the modal silently degrades into a full-page navigation.
- Preservation rule:
  - `Open profile` must continue to perform an intentional full navigation to `/pokedex/[pokemon]`.
  - `Quick view` must remain an overlay interaction when launched from `/pokedex`.
- Route rule:
  - Keep the intercepted route under `src/app/pokedex/@modal/(.)[pokemon]/*`.
  - Do not introduce a second competing detail route just for modal state unless reproduction proves the current route seam is fundamentally broken.
- Verification rule:
  - This fix needs browser-level regression coverage, not just lint/type/build, because the failure mode is navigation behavior.
